verdict.rationale: A single community user calls the free tier 'generous': 300k embeddings used only 10% of capacity, with no need to upgrade. Another community user said starter-account signups were blocked during a demand spike, which suggests access was at times constrained. Neither post is first-party pricing documentation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of free-tier limits and terms, current independent corroboration, clarity on free-tier signup availability.
